title: 朱光耀：前三季度增量5.7万亿，全年7万亿？
speaker: Zhu Guangyao

segments.en: Speaking exclusively to Bloomberg, Zhu Guangyao also expressed confidence that Chinese economy will be able to maintain growth within the official target range. In the first three quarters of Chinese economic growth is 4.5, certainly in the range, and the good thing is the differential rate that's 1.5 percent.
segments.zh: 朱光耀在接受彭博独家采访时表示，有信心中国经济能保持在官方目标区间内。前三季度中国经济增速为4.5%，肯定在区间内，好的是平减指数为1.5%。

segments.en: Difulator gives us 1.5 positive contribution, that means in the third quarter of Chinese nominal GDP growth is 6 percent.
segments.zh: 平减指数带来1.5个百分点的正贡献，这意味着三季度中国名义GDP增速为6%。

segments.en: That's new increase among Chinese economy in the fourth three quarters is 5.7 trillion yuan.
segments.zh: 这意味着前三季度中国经济新增量为5.7万亿元。

segments.en: This is highest level in the same period in the last five years. I think that's a very great contribution.
segments.zh: 这是过去五年同期最高水平。我认为这是非常大的贡献。

segments.en: And I guess, year as a whole, Chinese economy new increment part will be reached to 7 trillion, let me be.
segments.zh: 我估计全年中国经济新增量将达到7万亿元。

segments.en: And I strongly believe with 155 years plan, Chinese economy will keep the development with 4.5 percent, 2.5 percent.
segments.zh: 我坚信在155规划下，中国经济将保持4.5%至5%的发展。

segments.en: Typically, next year is the second year of China's 155 year plan. I have strong belief, more than 4.5 percent growth, and the different rate will be more than 1.5 percent.
segments.zh: 明年是中国155规划的第二年。我坚信增速将超过4.5%，平减指数将超过1.5%。

segments.en: I think that we have confidence to keep nominal growth, I know only is more than 6 percent.
segments.zh: 我认为我们有信心保持名义增速在6%以上。
